title: EvalAttestation (v1)
description: The signed third-party-measurement artifact. Envelope law: verifyEvalAttestation in @motebit/crypto — establishes 'this issuer said this about this subject', never measurement truth.

eval_kind.description: Measurement family — closed EvalKind registry; a consumer that cannot interpret the family fails closed.

motebit_id.description: The measured party. MAY equal the issuer's (self-issued floor).

artifact_digests.description: Content addresses of the subject artifacts the measurement consumed.

subject.description: The measured party (subject ≠ signer is the category law; subject MAY equal issuer as the self-issued floor).

public_key.description: Issuer's Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex — self-describing.

issuer.description: The measuring party — the SIGNER; its key is embedded self-describingly.

issued_at.description: Unix ms — when the measurement was signed.

expires_at.description: Optional issuer-declared staleness bound. Carried, consumer-policied; the verify law does NOT enforce it.

timestamp_ms.description: Wall-clock ms the public evidence reads were performed.

anchor.description: Deterministic chain anchor consulted during the reads, when any.

as_of.description: The evidence-read basis — an attestation says what was true AS-OF, never timelessly.

check.description: Measurement identifier — free-form snake_case BY CONVENTION (issuer-owned check catalog); the embedded verdict carries the interop-law values.

type.description: What the verdict is about (the closed VerdictSubject union).

integrity.description: Did the signature verify over canonical bytes?

identityBinding.description: The identity-binding rung — how strongly the key is bound to the motebit_id.

authority.description: Whether the authority covering the action holds. `unknown` is never a pass.

status.description: Revocation status. `unchecked` NEVER reads as "not revoked".

freshness.description: Present when `status` derives from a freshness basis.

basis.description: Evidence-grade ladder, weakest to strongest. The verdict carries the basis; the consumer holds the tolerance.

timestamp_ms.description: Wall-clock ms the revocation set was current as of, when known.

anchor.description: Deterministic chain anchor the set was current as of, when known.

revocation.description: The revocation axis: status plus how that status was established.

temporalBasis.description: The temporal basis time-dependent axes were evaluated against.

ref.description: Pointer to the evidence (a digest, a key id, a revocation root).

provenance.description: Optional re-verifiable provenance — digest over raw bytes + verbatim span (evidence-provenance-v1).

algorithm.description: Content-digest hash algorithm — `sha-256` today; agile by registry append.

value.description: Lowercase hex digest of the RAW, independently-obtainable bytes under `algorithm`.

digest.description: Content address of the raw primary-record bytes a third party can independently fetch — NEVER the projected text.

projection.description: Opaque, app-owned projection recipe id (e.g. agency.html-text.v1). Absent ⇒ the span is located over the raw bytes directly; present ⇒ a re-verifier applies the consumer-injected recipe, else fails closed (projection_unresolved).

projectionClass.description: Assurance class of a present projection: `spec-reproducible` (§7 — independently reimplementable from spec, the default) or `tool-pinned` (§7-tool — reproducible only by running the recipe's content-addressed pinned tool). ABSENT ⇒ spec-reproducible (the weaker class is opt-in). Carried, NOT verified by the law — the consumer policies on it.

span.description: The verbatim span asserted PRESENT in projection(bytes) — the law's subject.

locator.description: Advisory locator narrowing where the span sits. NOT load-bearing — the law is exact-substring presence, never a second thing a re-verifier must reproduce.

binding.description: Opaque resolved-identity reference (a motebit_id or a domain token the consumer resolves). CARRIED, NOT verified by the law — issuer authority is app-layer.

items.description: A reference to the evidence an axis or attestation was established from.

evidenceBasis.description: The evidence each axis was established from.

repair.description: Present whenever any axis is not passing; absent only on a clean pass.

summary.description: One-line human summary of what's wrong.

canonical.description: The canonical source of truth to consult or fix, when applicable.

fix.description: The concrete next step to establish the axis.

verdict.description: The structured per-axis verification verdict — DELIBERATELY no top-level `valid` boolean; a consumer branches on the axis it depends on.

items.description: One named measurement inside an attestation.

results.description: The measurements. Non-empty — an attestation that measured nothing is rejected.

evidence.description: Attestation-level evidence — unsigned observations that informed the audit but are not measurements.

ref.description: Pointer to the evidence (a digest, a key id, a revocation root).

provenance.description: Optional re-verifiable provenance — digest over raw bytes + verbatim span (evidence-provenance-v1).

value.description: Lowercase hex digest of the RAW, independently-obtainable bytes under `algorithm`.

digest.description: Content address of the raw primary-record bytes a third party can independently fetch — NEVER the projected text.

projection.description: Opaque, app-owned projection recipe id (e.g. agency.html-text.v1). Absent ⇒ the span is located over the raw bytes directly; present ⇒ a re-verifier applies the consumer-injected recipe, else fails closed (projection_unresolved).

projectionClass.description: Assurance class of a present projection: `spec-reproducible` (§7 — independently reimplementable from spec, the default) or `tool-pinned` (§7-tool — reproducible only by running the recipe's content-addressed pinned tool). ABSENT ⇒ spec-reproducible (the weaker class is opt-in). Carried, NOT verified by the law — the consumer policies on it.

span.description: The verbatim span asserted PRESENT in projection(bytes) — the law's subject.

locator.description: Advisory locator narrowing where the span sits. NOT load-bearing — the law is exact-substring presence, never a second thing a re-verifier must reproduce.

binding.description: Opaque resolved-identity reference (a motebit_id or a domain token the consumer resolves). CARRIED, NOT verified by the law — issuer authority is app-layer.

items.description: A reference to the evidence an axis or attestation was established from.

invocation.description: Cross-reference into the issuer's execution ledger.

signature.description: Ed25519 over canonicalJson({...attestation minus signature}), base64url.
